mapper.sql: k.review_status = 'VERIFIED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(k.source_path), '') IS NOT NULL AND (k.chapter_id IS NULL OR kc.status = 'PUBLISHED') AND (k.resource_id IS NULL OR ( r.review_status = 'VERIFIED' AND rc.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(r.source_name), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(r.version_label), '') IS NOT NULL ))
CASE WHEN k.resource_id IS NULL THEN k.license_scope ELSE r.license_scope END
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE source_path LIKE #{prefix}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO knowledge_chunks (id, chapter_id, title, content, source_path, page_label, review_status, license_scope) VALUES
(#{chunk.id}, #{chunk.chapterId}, #{chunk.title}, #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.source}, #{chunk.pageLabel}, 'VERIFIED', 'CLASSROOM_ONLY')
mapper.select: SELECT k.id, k.chapter_id AS chapterId, k.title, k.content, k.source_path AS source, k.page_label AS pageLabel, AS licenseScope FROM knowledge_chunks k LEFT JOIN chapters kc ON kc.id = k.chapter_id LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id = k.resource_id LEFT JOIN chapters rc ON rc.id = r.chapter_id WHERE ORDER BY k.source_path, k.id
